Subject: Lanmore Home & Garden - Questions on Submission

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the Lanmore Home & Garden submission. I have everything I need to start working this up, and the risk looks like a good fit for us.

Before I can finalize a quote, I need some additional information:

- What are the primary operations at each location?
- Are there any seasonal exposures (e.g., garden center, outdoor displays)?
- What protection class applies to each location?
- Any updates to values or operations since the application date?

Once I have these details, I'll be able to put together competitive terms for the 12/10/2026 effective date.

Thanks, and please let me know if you have any questions!

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
